# mortensor

Flexible probabilistic mortality forecasting from data observed at
different granularities: age groups and open age intervals, single or
grouped periods, population strata and causes.

mortensor has no preferred model. It implements common mortality models
and wraps others from demography, StMoMo, StanMoMo, bamp and forecast
behind one interface: every model is fitted with
[`mt_fit()`](reference/mt_fit.md), forecast with
[`mt_forecast()`](reference/mt_forecast.md) and returns simulated paths
of the same form. Models can therefore be compared in the same backtest
and combined into ensembles of any composition, and the same steps
(smoothing, jump-off, recalibration, coherent totals) apply to all of
them.

> **Caution: experimental, vibe-coded software. Use at your own risk.**
> mortensor is written largely with AI coding assistants (“vibe-coded”).
> It has unit tests that check its methods against published results and
> reference implementations, but it has not been peer reviewed, its
> interfaces still change, and its results can be wrong in ways the
> tests do not catch. Check results independently before you use them in
> publications, reports or decisions.

**Status:** version 0.2 is a rewrite in development (see
`dev/progress.md`).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("kalleEF/mortensor")
```

Requires R \>= 4.3.0. Hard dependencies are data.table and Matrix;
models and data adapters that build on other packages (forecast, bamp,
StMoMo, StanMoMo, demography, ggplot2) use them when installed.

## What it does

| Layer | Functions |
|----|----|
| Data at any granularity | [`mt_data()`](reference/mt_data.md) (long or wide tables, symbols for suppressed cells, shared populations), [`mt_add()`](reference/mt_add.md), [`as_mt_data()`](reference/as_mt_data.md) (StMoMo, demography), [`mt_from_hmd()`](reference/mt_from_hmd.md), [`mt_read_hmd()`](reference/mt_from_hmd.md), [`mt_read_genesis()`](reference/mt_read_genesis.md), [`mt_read_gbe()`](reference/mt_read_gbe.md), [`mt_validate()`](reference/mt_validate.md), `ons_data`, `de_deaths` |
| Preparation | [`mt_as_exposure()`](reference/mt_as_exposure.md), [`mt_subset()`](reference/mt_subset.md), [`mt_group_levels()`](reference/mt_group_levels.md) (aggregation layers: cause groups, quintiles, regions), [`mt_relabel()`](reference/mt_relabel.md), [`mt_fill_suppressed()`](reference/mt_fill_suppressed.md) |
| Harmonisation | [`mt_regroup()`](reference/mt_regroup.md), [`mt_ungroup()`](reference/mt_ungroup.md) (penalized composite link model with exposure offset, 1D/2D; monotone interpolation; deprecated spline and GAM methods), [`mt_plot_ungroup()`](reference/ungroup-diagnostics.md) and [`mt_ungroup_check()`](reference/ungroup-diagnostics.md) (diagnostics), [`mt_smooth()`](reference/mt_smooth.md) (over age, over time or both; P-splines, Whittaker, GAM), [`mt_smooth_check()`](reference/mt_smooth_check.md), [`mt_plot_smooth()`](reference/mt_smooth_check.md) |
| Preprocessing pipelines | [`mt_prep()`](reference/mt_prep.md) with [`step_ungroup()`](reference/mt_prep.md), [`step_smooth()`](reference/mt_prep.md), [`step_regroup()`](reference/mt_prep.md), [`step_grid()`](reference/mt_prep.md), [`step_shocks()`](reference/mt_prep.md), [`step_window()`](reference/mt_prep.md); models fitted to smoothed rates take their observation noise from the raw rates |
| Describing the past | [`mt_observed()`](reference/mt_observed.md), [`life_expectancy()`](reference/life_expectancy.md), [`asr()`](reference/derived.md), [`prob_dying()`](reference/derived.md) on data, [`mt_contrast()`](reference/mt_contrast.md) (gaps, ratios), [`mt_inequality()`](reference/mt_inequality.md) (SII, RII), [`lifespan_variation()`](reference/lifespan_variation.md) (e-dagger, entropy, Gini, standard deviation, IQR), [`standard_population()`](reference/standard_population.md) |
| Models | [`rwd()`](reference/rwd.md), [`lee_carter()`](reference/lee_carter.md) (Poisson or SVD with the adjustments and period choice of demography; optional rotation of the age pattern, Li, Lee and Gerland 2013; negative binomial deaths, Delwarde, Denuit and Partrat 2007), [`coda()`](reference/coda.md) (compositional model of life-table deaths and its coherent version, Oeppen 2008; Bergeron-Boucher et al. 2017), [`p_splines()`](reference/p_splines.md) (two-dimensional P-splines, Currie, Durban and Eilers 2004), [`cp_splines()`](reference/cp_splines.md) (constrained P-splines, Camarda 2019), [`bohk_rau()`](reference/bohk_rau.md) (age-specific rates of mortality improvement, Bohk-Ewald and Rau 2017), [`arima_series()`](reference/arima_series.md), [`ets_series()`](reference/arima_series.md), [`hyndman_ullah()`](reference/hyndman_ullah.md) (demography), [`stmomo()`](reference/stmomo.md) (APC, CBD, RH, M6, M7, M8, Plat, LC), [`apci()`](reference/apci.md) (age-period-cohort-improvement model, Richards et al. 2019), [`stanmomo()`](reference/stanmomo.md) (LC, RH, APC, CBD and M6, Bayesian, in Stan), [`li_lee()`](reference/li_lee.md), [`cae()`](reference/cae.md) (common age effect model, Kleinow 2015), [`saint()`](reference/saint.md) (trend of a reference population and stationary spreads, Jarner and Kryger 2011; Jarner and Jallbjørn 2022), [`coherent_fdm()`](reference/coherent_fdm.md) (demography), [`apc_bayes()`](reference/apc_bayes.md) and [`apc_select()`](reference/apc_select.md) (bamp), [`nordpred_apc()`](reference/nordpred_apc.md) (Nordpred age-period-cohort model, Møller et al. 2003); experimental: [`tucker3()`](reference/tucker3.md) (three-way Lee-Carter), [`coda_multiway()`](reference/coda_multiway.md) (multiway compositional model, Bergeron-Boucher et al. 2018), [`coda_causes()`](reference/coda_causes.md); deprecated: [`product_ratio()`](reference/product_ratio.md), [`cause_shares()`](reference/cause_shares.md) |
| Wrappers for any model | [`ensemble()`](reference/ensemble.md) (weights from inner backtests: stacking of predictive distributions with the CRPS, Yao et al. 2018; life expectancy bias, Kontis et al. 2017; inverse CRPS; `top_k`), [`stratified()`](reference/stratified.md) (different models for groups of strata), [`reconciled()`](reference/reconciled.md) (optionally with the Schaake shuffle of Clark et al. 2004 and MinT weights from past errors), [`coupled()`](reference/coupled.md) and [`mt_couple()`](reference/coupled.md) (separate forecasts given the dependence of a joint model by ensemble copula coupling, Schefzik et al. 2013), [`recalibrated()`](reference/recalibrated.md) (spread fitted to the errors of the last 10 years, optionally by age band or for life expectancy), [`anchored()`](reference/anchored.md) (jump-off at the observed level), [`bootstrapped()`](reference/bootstrapped.md), [`tuned()`](reference/mt_tune.md) and [`mt_tune()`](reference/mt_tune.md) (model and preprocessing settings chosen by forecast accuracy on the last years: hold-out or rolling origins, full or two-stage grids) |
| Coherence | [`mt_hierarchy()`](reference/mt_hierarchy.md), [`mt_aggregate_strata()`](reference/mt_aggregate_strata.md), [`mt_reconcile()`](reference/mt_reconcile.md) and [`reconciled()`](reference/reconciled.md) (bottom-up, WLS, MinT, structural, OLS, proportional; draw by draw; non-negative; `fixed` nodes such as a trusted all-cause total; score-optimal reconciliation learnt from past forecasts, Panagiotelis et al. 2023), [`mt_coherence()`](reference/mt_coherence.md), [`mt_plot_coherence()`](reference/mt_coherence.md), [`mt_aggregate_draws()`](reference/mt_aggregate_draws.md), [`mt_order_strata()`](reference/mt_order_strata.md) |
| Forecasts | [`mt_fit()`](reference/mt_fit.md), [`summary()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html), [`mt_parameters()`](reference/mt_parameters.md), [`residuals()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/residuals.html), [`mt_forecast()`](reference/mt_forecast.md) (simulated paths), [`mt_jump_off()`](reference/mt_jump_off.md), [`mt_summarise()`](reference/mt_draws.md), [`mt_deaths()`](reference/mt_deaths.md), [`mt_disaggregate()`](reference/mt_disaggregate.md) with [`mt_shape_rates()`](reference/mt_shape_rates.md) and [`mt_disaggregate_check()`](reference/mt_disaggregate_check.md) |
| Evaluation and comparison | [`mt_backtest()`](reference/mt_backtest.md) (rolling origin, no leakage; rates, life expectancy, ASR), [`mt_score()`](reference/mt_score.md) (CRPS, WIS, coverage, PIT, MAE, RMSE, MASE; also of gaps between strata), [`mt_compare()`](reference/mt_compare.md) and [`mt_score_table()`](reference/mt_compare.md) (several models in one backtest, by level of a hierarchy), [`mt_dm_test()`](reference/mt_dm_test.md) (Diebold-Mariano tests of differences in accuracy), [`mt_compare_forecasts()`](reference/mt_compare.md), [`mt_plot_compare()`](reference/mt_compare.md), [`mt_plot_backtest_design()`](reference/mt_plot_design.md), [`mt_plot_tuning()`](reference/mt_plot_design.md), [`mt_plot_pit()`](reference/mt_plot_design.md) |
| Decomposition | [`mt_decompose()`](reference/mt_decompose.md) (differences by age, cause and subgroup: Arriaga, Horiuchi, stepwise replacement, Kitagawa, and Arriaga meets Kitagawa for subgroup composition; on observed data, forecast draws or both), [`mt_plot_decomposition()`](reference/mt_plot_decomposition.md) |
| Excess mortality | [`mt_excess()`](reference/mt_excess.md) (observed minus expected deaths or life expectancy, with intervals from a baseline model; by age, stratum and year, cumulative), [`mt_plot_excess()`](reference/mt_excess.md) |
| Results and plots | [`life_table()`](reference/life_table.md), [`life_expectancy()`](reference/life_expectancy.md), [`prob_dying()`](reference/derived.md), [`asr()`](reference/derived.md), [`yll()`](reference/derived.md), [`mt_contrast()`](reference/mt_contrast.md), [`mt_inequality()`](reference/mt_inequality.md), [`lifespan_variation()`](reference/lifespan_variation.md), [`mt_plot_forecast()`](reference/mt_plot.md), [`mt_plot_life_expectancy()`](reference/mt_plot.md), [`mt_plot_contrast()`](reference/mt_plot_contrast.md), [`mt_plot_scores()`](reference/mt_plot_more.md), [`mt_plot_shares()`](reference/mt_plot_more.md), [`theme_mortensor()`](reference/mt_plot_style.md), [`mt_export()`](reference/mt_export.md), [`as_demogdata()`](reference/as_demogdata.md), [`as_stmomodata()`](reference/as_demogdata.md) |

## Function map

The objects of an analysis and the functions that connect them. The
[function map](vignettes/articles/function-map.Rmd) (on the website:
Articles, Function map) shows every function with its purpose, the
possible workflows and what the package does not cover.

![Function map: your tables become an mt_data object with mt_data();
mt_fit() fits a model specification to it; mt_forecast() gives mt_draws,
simulated future rates; mt_backtest() gives backtest scores (mt_score(),
mt_dm_test()); results such as life_expectancy(), lifespan_variation(),
asr(), mt_contrast(), mt_decompose(), mt_excess(), plots and CSV files
come from the draws or from the observed
data.](reference/figures/README-function-map.png)

## Example

``` r

library(mortensor)

# deaths and populations by sex, age group and deprivation decile, England
# 2001-2019 (ONS; Open Government Licence)
x <- mt_data(deaths = ons_data, population = ons_data, by = c("sex", "imd_decile"),
             age = "age_group", value = c(deaths = "all_causes", population = "population"))
x <- mt_as_exposure(x, type = "midyear")
# deciles to quintiles: an aggregation layer with its own name
x <- mt_group_levels(x, "imd_decile", function(d) paste0("Q", ceiling(as.numeric(d) / 2)),
                     name = "quintile")
mt_validate(x)

fit <- mt_fit(li_lee(common_by = "sex"), x)
fc <- mt_forecast(fit, h = 15, n_draws = 500, seed = 1)
life_expectancy(fc, at = 0)

bt <- mt_backtest(li_lee(common_by = "sex"), x, origins = 2008:2014, h = 5)
mt_score(bt)
```

Vignettes:

- **Start**: *Getting started*, *Your own data, from CSV to report*.
- **Concepts, one at a time**: *Ungrouping age groups: methods and
  diagnostics*, *Smoothing death rates*, *Where a forecast starts: the
  jump-off*, *Backtesting and scores*, *Tuning and recalibration*,
  *Coherent forecasts: totals and their parts*, *Decomposing differences
  in life expectancy*.
- **Models**: *Choosing and combining models* (implemented and wrapped
  models side by side, ensembles of any combination), *Model reference*,
  *Bayesian age-period-cohort models with bamp*, *Comparison with
  demography, bamp and StMoMo*.
- **Applications**: *Inequality in England: life expectancy and causes
  of death by deprivation* (ONS), *Causes of death by deprivation:
  coherent and combined forecasts* (ONS), *Differences between the
  German Laender* (Destatis).
- **Help**: *Frequently asked questions*, *Function map*.

# Package index

## 

Read data

Deaths, exposures and populations in long or wide tables, at any age and
period resolution.

- [`mt_data()`](mt_data.md) : Mortality data observed at any granularity

- [`mt_add()`](mt_add.md) [`mt_add_deaths()`](mt_add.md)
  [`mt_add_exposure()`](mt_add.md) [`mt_add_population()`](mt_add.md) :

  Add observations to an `mt_data` object

- [`parse_age_labels()`](parse_age_labels.md) : Parse age-group labels

- [`as_mt_data()`](as_mt_data.md) : Convert other mortality data formats

- [`mt_from_hmd()`](mt_from_hmd.md) [`mt_read_hmd()`](mt_from_hmd.md) :
  Human Mortality Database tables

- [`mt_read_genesis()`](mt_read_genesis.md) : Read deaths and
  populations from GENESIS (Destatis) flat files

- [`mt_read_gbe()`](mt_read_gbe.md) : Read tables exported from GBE-Bund

## 

Prepare and check

Analysis decisions on exposures, ages, years, strata, aggregation layers
and suppressed cells.

- [`mt_as_exposure()`](mt_as_exposure.md) : Exposures from population
  counts

- [`mt_subset()`](mt_subset.md) : Restrict data to ages, periods and
  strata

- [`mt_group_levels()`](mt_group_levels.md) : Combine levels of a
  stratum variable

- [`mt_relabel()`](mt_relabel.md) : Rename levels of a stratum variable

- [`mt_fill_suppressed()`](mt_fill_suppressed.md) : Estimate suppressed
  death counts

- [`mt_validate()`](mt_validate.md) : Check mortality data for common
  problems

- [`mt_strata()`](mt_strata.md) [`mt_obs()`](mt_strata.md)
  [`mt_grid()`](mt_strata.md)
  [`as.data.table(`*`<mt_data>`*`)`](mt_strata.md) :

  Strata, grid and tables of an `mt_data` object

## 

Harmonise age groups and periods

Common resolution of all tables; ungrouping and smoothing; preprocessing
pipelines refitted in backtests.

- [`mt_regroup()`](mt_regroup.md) : Regroup data onto coarser age or
  period intervals
- [`mt_ungroup()`](mt_ungroup.md) : Estimate grid-resolution data from
  grouped observations
- [`mt_plot_ungroup()`](ungroup-diagnostics.md)
  [`mt_ungroup_check()`](ungroup-diagnostics.md) : Diagnostics of
  ungrouped data
- [`mt_smooth()`](mt_smooth.md) : Smooth death rates on the grid
- [`mt_smooth_check()`](mt_smooth_check.md)
  [`mt_plot_smooth()`](mt_smooth_check.md) : Check and plot the result
  of smoothing
- [`mt_prep()`](mt_prep.md) [`step_ungroup()`](mt_prep.md)
  [`step_smooth()`](mt_prep.md) [`step_regroup()`](mt_prep.md)
  [`step_grid()`](mt_prep.md) [`step_window()`](mt_prep.md)
  [`step_shocks()`](mt_prep.md) [`mt_prep_apply()`](mt_prep.md) :
  Preprocessing pipelines
- [`mt_set_grid()`](mt_set_grid.md) : Set the modelling grid

## 

Describe the past

Observed indicators with Poisson intervals, gaps between strata,
inequality indices, lifespan variation, decompositions and excess
mortality (which also work on forecasts).

- [`mt_observed()`](mt_observed.md) : Observed rates as draws
- [`life_expectancy()`](life_expectancy.md) : Life expectancy from rates
  or forecast draws
- [`prob_dying()`](derived.md) [`asr()`](derived.md)
  [`yll()`](derived.md) : Derived quantities from forecast draws or
  observed data
- [`mt_contrast()`](mt_contrast.md) : Differences and ratios between
  strata, path by path
- [`mt_plot_contrast()`](mt_plot_contrast.md) : Plot gaps between strata
  over time
- [`mt_inequality()`](mt_inequality.md) : Slope and relative index of
  inequality, path by path
- [`lifespan_variation()`](lifespan_variation.md) : Lifespan variation
  from rates or forecast draws
- [`mt_decompose()`](mt_decompose.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mt_decomposition>`*`)`](mt_decompose.md) : Decompose
  differences in mortality by age, cause and subgroup
- [`mt_plot_decomposition()`](mt_plot_decomposition.md) : Plot a
  decomposition
- [`standard_population()`](standard_population.md) : Standard
  populations
- [`life_table()`](life_table.md) : Life tables from death rates on any
  age axis
- [`mt_open_check()`](mt_open_check.md) : Check old-age mortality models
  out of sample
- [`mt_excess()`](mt_excess.md) [`mt_plot_excess()`](mt_excess.md) :
  Excess mortality

## 

Models for one population

- [`lee_carter()`](lee_carter.md) : Lee-Carter model
- [`rwd()`](rwd.md) : Random walk with drift on log death rates
- [`p_splines()`](p_splines.md) : Two-dimensional P-spline model
- [`cp_splines()`](cp_splines.md) : Smooth constrained mortality
  forecasting (CP-splines)
- [`hyndman_ullah()`](hyndman_ullah.md) : Functional demographic model
  of Hyndman and Ullah (demography)
- [`coda()`](coda.md) : Compositional data (CoDa) model of life-table
  deaths
- [`bohk_rau()`](bohk_rau.md) : Bohk-Ewald and Rau model of age-specific
  rates of mortality improvement
- [`stmomo()`](stmomo.md) : Generalised age-period-cohort models
  (StMoMo)
- [`apci()`](apci.md) : Age-period-cohort-improvement (APCI) model
- [`stanmomo()`](stanmomo.md) : Bayesian stochastic mortality models in
  Stan (StanMoMo)
- [`arima_series()`](arima_series.md) [`ets_series()`](arima_series.md)
  : Per-age ARIMA and ETS models
- [`apc_bayes()`](apc_bayes.md) : Bayesian age-period-cohort model
  (bamp)
- [`apc_select()`](apc_select.md) : Choose the random-walk orders of a
  Bayesian APC model by DIC
- [`mcmc_control()`](mcmc_control.md) : MCMC settings for apc_bayes()
- [`nordpred_apc()`](nordpred_apc.md) : Nordpred age-period-cohort model
  with a power link

## 

Models for several populations and causes

- [`li_lee()`](li_lee.md) : Li-Lee coherent multi-population model
- [`cae()`](cae.md) : Common age effect model for several populations
- [`coherent_fdm()`](coherent_fdm.md) : Coherent functional demographic
  model (product-ratio, demography)
- [`coda_multiway()`](coda_multiway.md) : Multiway compositional (CoDa)
  model of life-table deaths for subpopulations
- [`saint()`](saint.md) : SAINT model: trend of a reference population
  and stationary spreads
- [`tucker3()`](tucker3.md) : Tucker3 tensor model across strata
  (three-way Lee-Carter model)
- [`cause_shares()`](cause_shares.md) : Coherent multi-cause forecasts
  with cause shares (deprecated)
- [`coda_causes()`](coda_causes.md) : Multiple-decrement CoDa model of
  causes of death (experimental)
- [`product_ratio()`](product_ratio.md) : Lee-Carter version of the
  product-ratio method (deprecated)

## 

Combine models and make forecasts coherent

Model wrappers (ensembles, different models for groups of strata,
reconciliation, coupling, calibration, jump-off, bootstrap, tuning) and
hierarchies of strata.

- [`ensemble()`](ensemble.md) : Ensembles of models
- [`stratified()`](stratified.md) : Different models for different
  groups of strata
- [`reconciled()`](reconciled.md) : Models with reconciled forecasts
- [`coupled()`](coupled.md) [`mt_couple()`](coupled.md) : Give separate
  forecasts the dependence of a joint model
- [`recalibrated()`](recalibrated.md) : Recalibrate forecast
  distributions on recent years
- [`anchored()`](anchored.md) : Control the jump-off of any model
- [`bootstrapped()`](bootstrapped.md) : Bootstrap uncertainty of
  preprocessing and parameters
- [`mt_tune()`](mt_tune.md) [`tuned()`](mt_tune.md) : Tune model and
  preprocessing settings by forecast accuracy
- [`mt_hierarchy()`](mt_hierarchy.md) : Hierarchies of strata
- [`mt_aggregate_strata()`](mt_aggregate_strata.md) : Add aggregate
  strata to data
- [`mt_reconcile()`](mt_reconcile.md) : Reconcile forecast draws over a
  hierarchy
- [`mt_coherence()`](mt_coherence.md)
  [`mt_plot_coherence()`](mt_coherence.md) : Check the coherence of
  forecast draws
- [`mt_aggregate_draws()`](mt_aggregate_draws.md) : Aggregate forecast
  draws over strata or ages
- [`mt_order_strata()`](mt_order_strata.md) : Enforce an ordering
  between strata in forecast draws

## 

Fit, inspect and forecast

- [`mt_fit()`](mt_fit.md) : Fit a model to mortality data
- [`mt_parameters()`](mt_parameters.md) : Parameters of a fitted model
- [`fitted(`*`<mt_fit>`*`)`](fit-inspection.md)
  [`residuals(`*`<mt_fit>`*`)`](fit-inspection.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mt_fit>`*`)`](fit-inspection.md) : Fitted rates,
  residuals and summaries of fitted models
- [`mt_plot_residuals()`](mt_plot_residuals.md) : Residual heat map of a
  fitted model
- [`mt_forecast()`](mt_forecast.md) : Forecast draws from a fitted model
- [`mt_jump_off()`](mt_jump_off.md) : Step between the last observed
  year and the first forecast year
- [`mt_summarise()`](mt_draws.md)
  [`as.data.table(`*`<mt_draws>`*`)`](mt_draws.md) : Forecast draws
- [`mt_deaths()`](mt_deaths.md) : Expected deaths from draws and future
  exposures
- [`mt_disaggregate()`](mt_disaggregate.md) : Disaggregate forecast
  draws to a finer age grid
- [`mt_shape_rates()`](mt_shape_rates.md) : Age shapes within groups for
  disaggregating forecasts
- [`mt_disaggregate_check()`](mt_disaggregate_check.md)
  [`mt_plot_disaggregation()`](mt_disaggregate_check.md) : Check and
  plot disaggregated forecasts

## 

Evaluate and compare

Rolling-origin backtests and scores; tests of differences in accuracy;
several models and forecasts side by side.

- [`mt_backtest()`](mt_backtest.md) : Rolling-origin backtest
- [`mt_score()`](mt_score.md) : Summarise backtest scores
- [`mt_dm_test()`](mt_dm_test.md) : Test differences in forecast
  accuracy between models (Diebold-Mariano)
- [`mt_compare()`](mt_compare.md) [`mt_score_table()`](mt_compare.md)
  [`mt_compare_forecasts()`](mt_compare.md)
  [`mt_plot_compare()`](mt_compare.md) : Compare models and forecasts
- [`mt_plot_backtest_design()`](mt_plot_design.md)
  [`mt_plot_tuning()`](mt_plot_design.md)
  [`mt_plot_pit()`](mt_plot_design.md) : Didactic plots of backtests and
  tuning

## 

Report

- [`mt_plot_forecast()`](mt_plot.md) [`mt_plot_age()`](mt_plot.md)
  [`mt_plot_life_expectancy()`](mt_plot.md)
  [`mt_plot_rates()`](mt_plot.md) [`mt_plot_coverage()`](mt_plot.md) :
  Plots
- [`mt_plot_tucker()`](mt_plot_more.md)
  [`mt_plot_shares()`](mt_plot_more.md)
  [`mt_plot_scores()`](mt_plot_more.md) : Further plots: Tucker factors,
  cause shares and backtest scores
- [`theme_mortensor()`](mt_plot_style.md)
  [`mt_palette()`](mt_plot_style.md)
  [`scale_colour_mortensor()`](mt_plot_style.md)
  [`scale_fill_mortensor()`](mt_plot_style.md) : Plot style of mortensor
- [`mt_export()`](mt_export.md) : Export forecasts and result tables

## Low level and extending

Building blocks for advanced use and for new models.

- [`mt_axis()`](mt_axis.md) [`single_ages()`](mt_axis.md)
  [`age_groups()`](mt_axis.md) [`single_years()`](mt_axis.md)

  axis
